subject: eng
title: Grammar 6A Ch 4: Correlative Conjunctions (either...or / neither...nor / both...and)

questions.q: After lunch, we can ___ go cycling ___ watch a film.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.15 & p.27：表示在兩個選擇中「或者……或者……（二選一）」用 either ... or。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: After lunch, we can ___ go cycling ___ watch a film.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 4: Correlative Conjunctions (either...or / neither...nor / both...and)

questions.q: ___ Bill ___ I can ride a bike, so let's watch a film instead.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.16 & p.27：表示「既不……也不……（兩個都不會）」用 Neither ... nor。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: ___ Bill ___ I can ride a bike, so let's watch a film instead.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 4: Correlative Conjunctions (either...or / neither...nor / both...and)

questions.q: ___ action films ___ romantic films are interesting to me. Let's watch a comedy.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.27 Section A Q5：否定兩種電影都無趣用 Neither action films nor romantic films。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: ___ action films ___ romantic films are interesting to me. Let's watch a comedy.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 4: Correlative Conjunctions (either...or / neither...nor / both...and)

questions.q: ___ Jenny ___ her brother like playing badminton. They play together every Saturday.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.18：表示「兩個都喜歡」用 Both ... and，謂語動詞用複數 like。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: ___ Jenny ___ her brother like playing badminton. They play together every Saturday.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 4: Correlative Conjunctions (either...or / neither...nor / both...and)

questions.q: Neither the king nor the queen ___ happy about the bad news.
questions.explain: 根據 Grammar 6A p.16–18：neither ... nor 連接兩個單數主語時，動詞跟隨鄰近單數主語用 is。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Neither the king nor the queen ___ happy about the bad news.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 4: Correlative Conjunctions (either...or / neither...nor / both...and)

questions.q: Fill in the blank (Grammar 6A p.15): You can have either apple juice ___ orange juice.
questions.explain: either 與 or 搭配（either ... or）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Fill in the blank (Grammar 6A p.15): You can have either apple juice ___ orange juice.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 4: Correlative Conjunctions (either...or / neither...nor / both...and)

questions.q: 'Neither Tom or Jerry likes cheese.' uses the correct pair of conjunctions.
questions.explain: Neither 必須與 nor 搭配（Neither Tom nor Jerry），不可用 or。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: 'Neither Tom or Jerry likes cheese.' uses the correct pair of conjunctions.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 6A Ch 4: Correlative Conjunctions (either...or / neither...nor / both...and)
